aka.en: Chinese section of the Kunming–Bangkok highway
aka.zh: 昆曼国际大通道（昆曼公路）中国段

tagline.en: Yunnan's road to Laos, built in six pieces over eighteen years, from Kunming down through the mountains of southern Yunnan and the Xishuangbanna rainforest to the border at Mohan
tagline.zh: 云南通往老挝的道路，十八年间分六段建成，自昆明南下，穿越滇南山区和西双版纳热带雨林，抵达磨憨口岸

end.en: Mohan, Mengla county, on the Laos border; the expressway ends at Shangyong, short of the port
end.zh: 勐腊县磨憨，中老边境；高速公路止于口岸以北的尚勇

en: G8511 runs south from Kunming by Yuxi, Yuanjiang, Mohei, Simao (in Pu'er) and Jinghong to the Laos border at Mohan, and is the Chinese part of the Kunming–Bangkok highway. It drops from the Yunnan plateau into the Red River valley at Yuanjiang, climbs back through the mountains to Simao, and then crosses the Xishuangbanna nature reserve, with its tropical rainforest and wild elephants, to the border.

It was built as six separate projects, to different standards, between 1997 and 2017. The oldest stretches are narrow and slow by present standards: of the six, only Kunming–Yuxi has six lanes, and some mountain sections were designed for 60 km/h.
zh: G8511 自昆明向南，经玉溪、元江、磨黑、思茅（今属普洱）、景洪，至中老边境磨憨，是昆曼国际大通道的中国段。它从云南高原下到元江的红河河谷，再翻山至思茅，然后穿过西双版纳自然保护区的热带雨林和野象栖息地，抵达边境。
全线在 1997 至 2017 年间分六个项目、按不同标准建成。最早的路段以今天的标准看偏窄偏慢：六段中只有昆玉段为六车道，部分山区路段设计时速只有 60 公里。

en: The mountain sections are where the money went. On Yuanjiang–Mohei, 147 km, bridges and tunnels make up 30% of the line, 43.45 km in all; its Honghe bridge over the Red River is 801 metres long and 163 metres high. It cut 67 km off the old road and the journey from about seven hours to two.

Simao–Xiaomengyang, 98 km, was the first expressway in China built through a national nature reserve and tropical rainforest. To spare the forest, the designers raised the line onto bridges 8 to 15 metres high where elephants cross and pushed more of it into tunnels: the number of bridges rose from 54 in the first design to 352, and tunnels from 2 to 30. The last section, Xiaomengyang–Mohan, 167 km, has 319 bridges and 33 tunnels, together 48.9% of its main line, including extra-long tunnels under the Tengmie and Nangong mountains.
zh: 钱主要花在山区路段。元江至磨黑段长 147 公里，桥隧比 30%，共 43.45 公里；其中跨越红河的红河大桥长 801 米、高 163 米。该段比老路缩短 67 公里，行车时间由约 7 小时缩短至 2 小时。
思茅至小勐养段长 98 公里，是中国第一条穿越国家级自然保护区和热带雨林的高速公路。为保护森林，设计者在野象出没处把路抬上 8 至 15 米高的桥，并更多地改走隧道：桥梁由最初设计的 54 座增至 352 座，隧道由 2 座增至 30 座。最后建成的小勐养至磨憨段长 167 公里，有桥梁 319 座、隧道 33 座，主线桥隧比 48.9%，其中包括藤篾山、南贡山特长隧道。

en: Kunming–Yuxi opened first, on 17 April 1999. Yuxi–Yuanjiang, begun in May 1997, opened on trial on 29 October 2000, and a vice-minister of communications later called it China's first true mountain expressway. Yuanjiang–Mohei opened on 28 December 2003 and Simao–Xiaomengyang on 6 April 2006. Yunnan's transport department declared the Chinese part of the Kunming–Bangkok highway basically complete on 21 March 2008, although the gap between Mohei and Simao was still being built: that section, begun on 27 December 2006, opened on 25 April 2011 by Yunnan Net's account, while the transport department's later list gives March 2012.

The southern end was the last. Xiaomengyang–Mohan, from the Yinhe hub to Shangyong, was begun in December 2015 and opened for trial operation on 28 September 2017, making the Chinese part expressway throughout. It passed the Ministry of Transport's completion acceptance in 2023.
zh: 昆明至玉溪段最先建成，1999 年 4 月 17 日通车。玉溪至元江段 1997 年 5 月开工，2000 年 10 月 29 日试通车，交通部一位副部长后来称其为中国第一条真正意义上的山区高速公路。元江至磨黑段 2003 年 12 月 28 日通车，思茅至小勐养段 2006 年 4 月 6 日通车。2008 年 3 月 21 日，云南省交通厅宣布昆曼公路中国段基本建成，而磨黑至思茅段仍在建设：该段 2006 年 12 月 27 日开工，据云南网报道于 2011 年 4 月 25 日通车，交通运输厅后来的答复则列为 2012 年 3 月。
南端最后建成。小勐养至磨憨段自银河枢纽至尚勇，2015 年 12 月开工，2017 年 9 月 28 日试运营通车，中国段至此全线高速化。2023 年该段通过交通运输部竣工验收。

en: The route was costed by section, and no total has been published. The sourced section figures, taking actual costs where they are known, add up to about 33 billion yuan in money of their day, nearly 40% of it for the last 167 km. The audit of Simao–Xiaomengyang found it built for 3.46 billion against a budget of 4.00 billion, and Yuxi–Yuanjiang came in at 3.93 billion against 4.10 billion.
A rebuild of Kunming–Yuxi, the oldest section, about 85 km, was estimated in 2024 at 15.5 billion yuan, about six times its reported original cost.
zh: 全线按路段分别核算，未公布总造价。有来源的分段数字（有实际造价的取实际造价）按当年价格合计约 333 亿元，其中近四成用于最后的 167 公里。审计显示，思茅至小勐养段概算 39.96 亿元，实际 34.57 亿元；玉溪至元江段概算 41.00 亿元，实际 39.26 亿元。
最早的昆玉段约 85 公里的改扩建工程，2024 年估算投资 155 亿元，约为据报道原造价的六倍。

en: The lanes and design speeds still follow the age of each section. Yunnan's transport department gives them, north to south, as six lanes at 100 km/h from Kunming to Yuxi; four lanes at 60 (in places 80) km/h to Yuanjiang; four at 60 to Mohei; and four at 80 from Mohei to Simao, Simao to Xiaomengyang and on to Mohan. Tolls on Xiaomengyang–Mohan may be collected for 30 years.
zh: 各段的车道数和设计时速仍取决于修建年代。据云南省交通运输厅，自北向南依次为：昆明至玉溪双向六车道，时速 100 公里；至元江四车道，时速 60（部分 80）公里；至磨黑四车道，时速 60 公里；磨黑至思茅、思茅至小勐养和小勐养至磨憨均为四车道，时速 80 公里。小勐养至磨憨段收费期为 30 年。

why.en: No route-wide figure is published. The route was built from 1997 to 2017 as six projects, each costed on its own; the sourced section figures are listed separately below.
why.zh: 未公布全线总造价。路线于 1997 至 2017 年间分六个项目建成，各段分别核算；有来源的分段数字另列如下。

label.zh: 昆明至玉溪段（85.71 公里，1999 年通车）

value.zh: 据报道为 25 亿元；未经官方来源核实

label.zh: 元江至磨黑段（147.37 公里，2003 年通车）

value.zh: 批复概算总投资 131.18 亿元；2015 年可行性研究批复估算约 125 亿元

figures.source: Yunnan Daily, 7 January 2024; China.com.cn, 18 December 2023; NDRC 发改基础〔2015〕628号

why.en: Each section was financed separately and no full breakdown has been found for the older ones. For Xiaomengyang–Mohan the 2015 approval set 4 billion yuan of capital — 2.086 billion of central vehicle purchase tax funds, 625 million from the province, 1.25 billion from Xishuangbanna prefecture and 39 million from Yunnan Highway Development Investment Co., the project owner — with the remaining 8.5 billion from domestic bank loans. Kunming–Yuxi is reported, by a weak encyclopedia source, to have been funded jointly by Hongta Group, the provincial transport department, Kunming and Yuxi; Mohei–Simao was a government–enterprise partnership with Yunnan Road and Bridge Co.; an Asian Development Bank loan to Yuanjiang–Mohei appears only in encyclopedia copies and has not been checked.
why.zh: 各段分别融资，较早路段未找到完整的出资构成。小勐养至磨憨段 2015 年批复资本金 40 亿元——中央车购税专项资金 20.86 亿元、省财政 6.25 亿元、西双版纳州财政 12.5 亿元、项目法人云南省公路开发投资有限责任公司自有资金 0.39 亿元——其余 85 亿元利用国内银行贷款。据较弱的百科来源，昆玉段由红塔集团、省交通厅、昆明市和玉溪市合资建设；磨思段采用政企合作方式，由云南路桥股份公司参与；元磨段利用亚洲开发银行贷款一说只见于百科转载，未经核实。

timeline.zh: 12 月，小勐养至磨憨段开工。

timeline.zh: 9 月 28 日，小勐养至磨憨段试运营通车，全线高速化。
